questions.q: According to the lesson, why does AI write in an 'average' voice by default?
options: AI tools are set to a neutral tone for legal reasons
Businesses usually paste in too many writing samples
It has learned from an enormous range of writing
Voice settings only exist on paid business plans
questions.explain: The lesson says AI defaults to an average voice because it has learned from an enormous range of writing, so you have to describe your voice explicitly and show examples.

questions.q: A team member at a landscaping firm wrote a prompt that worked well the first time she used it. When should it join the team prompt library?
options: After it has produced good results at least three times
Right away, so the rest of the team can start testing it
Once the owner approves its wording at a team meeting
After every person on the team has tried it at least once
questions.explain: The lesson sets a quality bar: a prompt joins the library only after it has produced good results at least three times.

questions.q: A florist tests her new brand voice guide, and the AI's rewrite of a product page still sounds stiff and salesy. What does the lesson suggest?
options: Make the guide longer by adding every past email as a sample
Ask the AI to rewrite the page in a more casual style instead
Stop using the guide and write all product pages by hand
Add that rewrite to the guide as a 'not this' example
questions.explain: In the testing step, the lesson says that wherever the result doesn't sound like you, add that example to the guide as a 'not this,' while keeping the guide to about one page.
